target_customer: Mobile app product, growth and design teams
problem: Mobile analytics sit in dashboards detached from the UI, so teams cannot see funnel and conversion data in the context of the actual screens.
business_model: B2B SaaS analytics subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: Mobile product analytics and growth intelligence

founders.name: Anton Krutiansky
prior_employers: Dropbox (tech lead on growth and mobile)

founders.name: Aram Aghababyan
previous_startups: Data and compute resource management platform for ML training jobs

competitors.name: UXCam
competitors.what: Mobile app analytics with screen naming and user journey flows

technical_complexity.rationale: Building an automatic UI graph across iOS and Android and overlaying analytics needs SDK and screen-structure work; the AI agent app analysis adds scale but uses existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Existing analytics vendors could add screen overlays; SDK integration and accumulated app graph data give mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; company is only months old.

market_need_then: Mobile teams use fragmented analytics tools; the founders cite their own growth experience at Dropbox and Life360, and AI coding tools raise iteration speed so measurement is the bottleneck.

identity.visual_style: New identity and website designed with Otherplace per an aggregator, reported February 2026
identity.voice_and_tone: Minimal and direct, tagline Your data in context.

brand_strength.rationale: Little public press about the brand; distinct compound name but similar to other Atlas-named companies.

outcome_analysis: AtlasGrid is a Fall 2025 company run by repeat YC founders with prior exits to Dropbox and Life360 and deep mobile growth experience, which is a strong founder-market fit. It is too early for an outcome. Funding is unverified and the market for mobile analytics is crowded with established vendors.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: search snippets attributed a 4M seed to the YC page, but the YC pages fetched did not show it; EveryDev says 1M seed in September 2025; VCBacked says 500K pre-seed December 2025. None recorded as a round. UXCam is listed from a 2025 roundup, not a dated launch comparison with AtlasGrid; competitor data is thin.
